title: Logical Reasoning
description: Class 1 IMO — Logical Reasoning: odd-one-out, grouping, analogy, series and position/direction, the reasoning section of the Maths Olympiad.

topics.title: Odd One Out and Grouping
topics.concept:
In odd one out, four things are shown and three are alike in some way. The one that is different is the answer. To solve it, ask: 'What do most of them have in common?'

Grouping means putting together things that belong with each other — like all the fruits, or all the animals.

examples.problem: Odd one out: apple, banana, mango, chair.
Which belongs with cow, goat, dog?
examples.solution: Another animal, such as cat (they are all animals).

recap: Odd one out = the one that is different from the rest.
Find what most of them share, then pick the one that doesn't.

quiz.q: Odd one out:  dog, cat, cow, rose.
quiz.explanation: Rose is a flower; the others are animals.

quiz.q: Which one is NOT a fruit?
quiz.explanation: Carrot is a vegetable; the others are fruits.

topics.title: Analogy and Series
topics.concept:
An analogy shows a pair that go together, then asks you to complete a second pair the same way. Example: cow is to calf as dog is to puppy.

A series is a list that follows a rule; you find the rule and give the next one.

examples.problem: Hand is to glove as foot is to ___ ?
examples.solution: Sock (or shoe) — what we wear on it.

recap: Analogy: find how the first pair is related, then match it.
Series: find the rule, then give the next item.

quiz.q: Bird is to nest as bee is to ___ ?
quiz.explanation: A bird lives in a nest; a bee lives in a hive.

topics.title: Position, Direction and Ranking
topics.concept: We describe position with words like top/bottom, left/right, inside/outside and first/last. In a line, ranking tells us who is 1st, 2nd, 3rd and so on.

examples.problem: In a race, who finishes first — the winner or the last runner?
If 4 children stand in a line, who is at the end?

quiz.q: 5 children stand in a line. Which child is in the middle?
quiz.explanation: With 5 in a line, the 3rd child is in the middle.

quiz.q: Riya is 2nd in line. How many children are ahead of her?

questions.q: Odd one out:  car, bus, train, banana.
questions.explanation: Banana is a fruit; the others are vehicles.

questions.q: Which does NOT belong with shirt, frock, trousers?
questions.explanation: Spoon is not clothing; the others are things we wear.

questions.q: Cow is to calf as hen is to ___ ?
questions.explanation: A baby hen is a chick.

questions.q: Day is to night as up is to ___ ?

questions.explanation: Letters going backward: after X comes W.

questions.q: Which is on your right hand if you face the front of the class — usually the ___ side?
questions.explanation: Your right hand is on your right side.

questions.q: 4 books are stacked. Which book is at the bottom touching the table?
questions.explanation: The 4th book is at the bottom.

questions.q: Aarav stands behind Riya, who is 1st. What is Aarav's position?
In a fruit basket there are 3 apples and 1 ball. Which one does NOT belong?
questions.explanation: A ball is not a fruit.

questions.q: 6 children stand in a line. Meera is 2nd from the front. How many children are behind her?
questions.explanation: 2 children up to Meera, so 6 − 2 = 4 behind her.

questions.q: In the series 1, 2, 4, 8, each number is double the one before. What comes next?
